title.narrative: Livelihood and Food Security Trust Fund (LIFT) - Phase II+III

description.narrative: Goal: To reduce by half the proportion of people in Myanmar living in poverty and reduce by half the proportion of people who suffer from hunger Purpose: Increase the income and nutrition status of poor rural people in Myanmar by focusing on interventions that increase income, food availability, utilization and stability of access to food. Outcomes: 1. Increased incomes of rural households 2. Improved market access and market terms for small holder farmers 3. Increased employment in non-farm activities for small holders and landless 4. Increased access to affordable financial services by small holders and landless 5. Improved diets of women, men and children 6. Safeguarded access to and sustainable use of natural resource for small holders and landless 7. Strengthened local capacity to support and promote food and livelihoods security 8. Generation of policy relevant evidence regarding small holder farmers and landless
